sections.heading: Verdict shape for RocketReach
sections.body:
Evaluator thesis: Yes for teams where Individual sellers and recruiters needing emails/phones matter more than polish elsewhere. Counter-signal: No when Buyers needing a deal pipeline CRM.

Capability hinge for this product: prospecting; data enrichment; lead management; contact management.

Integrations in research: Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Salesloft.

Paid tiers that usually matter in evaluation: Essentials, Pro, Ultimate.

sections.heading: Who RocketReach is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Individual sellers and recruiters needing emails/phones.

Avoid if: Buyers needing a deal pipeline CRM.

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with Apollo.io on the same job-to-be-done.

sections.heading: RocketReach price/value and next evaluation step
sections.body:
No free/trial flag in SG data — scope a paid proof with exit criteria before annual seats.

Tradeoff to accept consciously: Transparent pricing vs deeper enterprise data platforms.

Next step: run prospecting end-to-end, then decide.
